statement: Design the machine-checkable completeness/replay certificate architecture needed to certify that every one of the 178 open numerical rows is covered by the eventual compressed enumerator, independently of which pruning route wins.

scope.quantifiers: every required even degree/genus row and every exact symmetry/intersection stratum used by production
scope.required_output: coverage manifest schema, replay verifier contract, duplicate/orbit accounting invariants, and fail-closed missing-stratum checks

notes: Do not assume a successful shard implies global row coverage.
Keep certificate independent enough to check whichever compression route becomes load-bearing.
